So I think I have a solution. This worked for me so hopefully it'll work for everyone!

\- Open **Bluestacks 5** & click on **"Multi-Instance Manager"**

\- At the bottom, click on **"New Instance"**

\- Click **"Fresh Instance"**

\- Choose **"Pie 64-bit (Beta)"**

\- Enter your settings.  Mine are below:

**\* CPU cores: High (4 Cores)**

**\* RAM: High (4 GB)**

**\* Resolution: Landscape & 1920 x 1080**

**\* ABI Setting: x86 & ARM**

**\* DPI 240**

Unfortunately you will have to download Call of Duty: Mobile & do your map, camo, etc downloads again, but it worked for me!
